A new version of VibeOffice is here

Every version of the desktop app is published on GitHub. Download the newest one there.

Get the latest version on GitHub

VibeOffice for Linux has no download yet: build the new version from its source on GitHub, or use VibeOffice in your browser, which is always the newest.

Get the source on GitHub

VibeOffice in your browser updates itself: open it again, or reload the page, to get the newest version.

Open VibeOffice

VibeOffice from the Mac App Store is updated by the App Store: open the App Store, choose Updates, then Update next to VibeOffice. If it isn't listed there, you have the newest version.

  • WindowsClose VibeOffice, then download VibeOffice-Windows-x64.zip, open it, run VibeOfficeSetup.exe and choose Update.
  • macOSQuit VibeOffice, then download VibeOffice-macOS.dmg, open it and drag VibeOffice into Applications, replacing the one there.
  • LinuxNo download yet: build the new version from its source on GitHub, or use VibeOffice in your browser.

Installed from the Mac App Store? The App Store updates it for you.
